reference_files.label: offline_pipeline/props/apce_12x6.json
reference_files.origin: UIUC propeller database (Selig), see the file's citation

sections.name: motor_electrical
sections.note: the build's motor is tmotor_velox_v2207_v3_kv1750; the table is for tmotor_mn3508_kv700

sections.name: uiuc_propeller
sections.note: Run points are evaluated at the run's NOMINAL rpm (from the file name); the table curves sit at the mean rpm of merged runs, so small differences are expected. Rows with outside_data = true are held edge values.

sections.name: battery_cited_points
sections.note: Cited points only. The nominal voltage is a mid-discharge average, so a difference at 50 % SOC is expected. The discharge curve itself is in battery_curve.

sections.name: battery_curve
sections.note: no published discharge curve is stored; the OCV curve in the database is an ASSUMED generic shape. Supply parts_db/validation/battery_curve_<battery id>.csv
